name: nimbus
description: Guide Codex work through grilling, planning, implementation, review, and an evidence-backed handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Guide one evidence-backed Codex Work Item
interface.longDescription: A local browser control plane for explicit $nimbus workflows: grill consequential choices, approve a plan, map implementation evidence, reconcile the result, and prepare or publish a handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nimbus to open a Work Item, grill consequential decisions, approve the plan, map implementation evidence, review the result, and prepare the handoff.
